The R5 published TestScript profile JSON exposes that same canonical(StructureDefinition) type.
additional_context: Current HEAD has no source/testscript tree and source/fhir.ini has no active testscript, testreport, or testplan resource entries. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed the testing resources from the current core build. FHIR-I minutes record the 2022-11-28 persuasive vote, and Zulip background confirms the intended TestScript.profile semantics.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No current FHIR core source was changed because the requested datatype correction is already present in R5 and the affected resource is no longer in the current build.
